title: Rory and the Soft Mossy Shore
verses:
The moon cast a glow on the soft mossy shore,
Where waves made a song as they tumbled no more.
And Rory walked slowly to look at the tide,
With Nia above in a quiet slow glide.

Then Psittaco chirped from a smooth polished stone,
"The river is quiet, the cool breeze has blown!"
And Ricky hopped down with a sleepy soft sigh,
To watch all the stars coming out in the sky.

Now Benny stepped close with a heavy deep thud,
And rested his head in the warm soothing mud.
While Tilly brought leaves that were shiny and green,
To make the most cozy bed ever yet seen.

The night settled in with a blanket of blue,
The tall quiet reeds were all covered in dew.
And Rory curled up as the gentle waves rolled,
While stories of bedtime were softly retold.

And Nia tucked wings as she sat on a mound,
While Psittaco nestled right into the ground.
With Ricky and Tilly fast snoring away,
They said their goodnights to the sleepy old day.

The stars kept on shining so lovely and bright,
To keep all the dinos secure in the night.
And Rory closed eyes in the cool river breeze,
As dreamland swept in through the whispering trees.
